chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ismail ibn Marrar, from Yunus, from one of our companions, from Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him), who said:

Indeed, Allah created the Prophets upon prophethood, so they will not be except prophets; and He created the believers upon faith, so they will not be except believers; and He lent faith to a people. So if He wills, He completes it for them, and if He wills, He takes it away from them.
He said: And among them, it flowed, so [there are] those who are stable and those who are temporary (deposited).
And he said to me: So-and-so had temporary faith. So when he lied against us, that faith of his was taken away.
ai.seo_question: What is the difference between permanent faith and temporary faith in Shia theology?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi elucidates the Shia doctrine of *al-Amānah* (temporary faith), distinguishing between innate, permanent faith in Prophets and true believers, and the contingent faith granted to others. It highlights the dynamic nature of belief, where faith is 'deposited' and can be revoked or confirmed based on divine decree and human actions, such as truthfulness or lying. This concept underscores the interplay between divine will (*mashī'ah*) and human agency in maintaining spiritual integrity.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ismail Bin Marrar, from Yunus, from one of our companions, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Allahazwj Created the Prophetsas upon the Prophet-hood, so they will not happen to be except for Prophetsas; and heazwj Created the Momineen upon the Emān, so they will not happen to be except for Momineen; and Lent Emān to a people. So if Heazwj so Desires, would Complete it for them, and if Heazwj so Desires would Confiscate it’.
He<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said: ‘And among them flowed the stable ones and the temporary ones’.
And heasws said to me: ‘So and so had temporary Emān. So when he lied against usasws, that Emān of his was Confiscated’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Isma’il ibn Marrar from Yunus from certain individuals of our people from abu al-Hassan (a.s.) who has said the following:

‘‘Allah has created the prophets with prophet-hood, thus, they are nothing else but prophets. He has created the believers upon belief and they are nothing else but believers. He has deposited belief in a people. If He wills He completes it in them and if He wishes He removes it from them.’
The Imam said, ‘About these people it is said, “. . . the permanent and transient. . . .” [6:98]
The Imam said to me, ‘The belief of so and so was temporary. When he made false statements against us his belief was removed.’”
